maddeler.e:
أتفاعل (form VI)
# أَتَفَاعَلُ (ʔatafāʕalu) /ʔa.ta.faː.ʕa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# أَتَفَاعَلَ (ʔatafāʕala) /ʔa.ta.faː.ʕa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
# أَتَفَاعَلْ (ʔatafāʕal) /ʔa.ta.faː.ʕal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَاعَلَ (tafāʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
